items.title: Stock Market LIVE: Sensex rebounds 300 pts from day's low; KEI Ind, M&M Fin lead MidCap losses

items.title: Indian Hotels gains 3% as analysts raise earnings estimates, target post Q2
items.description: Indian Hotels' Q2 consolidated profit rose 23 per cent to ₹349 crore, while its revenue saw a 21 per cent year-on-year (YoY) growth to ₹2,566 crore.

items.title: Lupin, SRF, TMPV, Maruti, NTPC among 74 BSE 500 stocks hit 52-week lows
items.description: Benchmark indices traded lower for the third consecutive session on Thursday, as selling across sectors amid elevated crude oil prices and concerns over corporate earnings weighed on sentiment.

items.title: Fusion CX lists at 5% premium over IPO price after 3.3x subscription
items.description: On the BSE, the stock listed at ₹292, a premium of 1.04 per cent, while on the NSE, the stock made its debut at ₹305, a premium of 5.54 per cent.

items.title: Nifty PSU vs Private Bank: Which banking index looks stronger on charts?
items.description: Nandish Shah of HDFC Securities reckons that both the Nifty PSU Bank and Nifty Private Bank indices look strong on charts, with the bias more favourable for the former index.

items.title: Multibagger penny stock: PC Jeweller zooms 9% post Q2 nos, debt-free status
items.description: PC Jeweller has announced plans to roll out up to 100 large-format showrooms across Tier I, Tier II and Tier III cities over the next 12-18 months.

items.title: Eternal shares defy market fall after Q2 results; brokerages remain bullish
items.description: The net profit of Eternal for the second quarter of financial year 2026-27 (Q2FY27) rose 92 per cent year-on-year (Y-o-Y) to ₹125 crore, compared to ₹65 crore in Q2FY26.

items.title: Mkt re-rating unlikely amid global uncertainty: Venugopal Manghat, HSBC MF
items.description: After a sharp run-up, valuations in parts of the SMID segment already factor in several years of strong growth, cautioned Venugopal Manghat, CIO at HSBC Mutual Fund.

items.title: Nifty can fall to 22500, says Jatin Gedia; shares 3 stock trading ideas

items.description: Stocks to buy today: The 22,200-22,400 zone is the next key support area, while the 23,000-23,300 zone is likely to cap the upside during any recovery.

items.title: ESDS, Advit among 9 listings with up to 220% rally YTD; more steam left?
items.description: Analysts attribute the strong performance of recent IPOs to investor preference for niche and differentiated businesses, backed by healthy growth expectations and high entry barriers in some segments.

items.title: eMudhra share price hits second straight 20% lower circuit; at 52-week low
items.description: The Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) has formed a special team to investigate the leak of private keys associated with web security certificates issued by eMudhra.

items.title: HDFC Bank stock dips 2% on huge volume; trades lower for third straight day
items.description: According to reports, HDFC Bank initiated an internal review into the alleged sharing of confidential information with outsiders by two senior executives.

items.title: Infosys Q2 results preview: Analysts see PAT rising 10%; guidance in focus
items.description: Infosys Q2 results preview: Brokerages said that the Street will watch for a possible revision in FY27 revenue growth guidance.

items.title: JSW Steel Q2 results preview: Adj. PAT could grow 60-110% YoY, say analysts
items.description: Elara Capital said that steel demand remained resilient, supported by channel restocking ahead of expected price hikes.

items.title: Silver ETFs dip nearly 3% as rate hike fears overshadow safe-haven appeal
items.description: HDFC Silver ETF was down 2.7 per cent, Tata Silver ETF, SBI Silver ETF, Kotak Silver ETF, UTI Silver ETF, Axis Silver ETF, Mirae Asset Silver ETF, and DSP Silver ETF were down over 2 per cent.

items.title: India Cements surges 22% in two days on heavy volume in weak market
items.description: Share price of India Cements soared 9% to ₹359 on the BSE with a combined 35.96 million shares representing 11.6% of the company's total equity changing hands on the NSE and BSE on Thursday.

items.title: Balkrishna Industries jumps 4% on inking deal with Italy-based Pirelli
items.description: Balkrishna Industries stock traded at its highest point in October after the company inked an agreement with Pirelli to produce 800,000 branded premium car tyres in India.

items.title: Adani Green shares extend fall to 5th day, down 4% as Q2 PAT dips 24% QoQ
items.description: Today is the fifth day of decline for Adani Green Energy shares, during which they have lost 8 per cent.

items.title: Swiggy slips 26% in 1 month, hits record low; stock down 46% from IPO price
items.description: Foreign portfolio investors reduced their holdings in Swiggy to 8.55% in the September 2026 quarter, down from 13.96% at the end of the June 2026 quarter, the shareholding pattern shows.

items.title: Colgate shares fall 2% ahead of Q2 show; eyes on 1st earnings under new CEO
items.description: The results will mark the first quarter under new MD and CEO Manish Anandani.

items.title: NCDEX launches NDEX, FINNDEX in push to become multi-segment exchange
items.description: NDEX tracks 20 large and liquid stocks while FINNDEX covers 15 financial companies, as the exchange expands beyond agricultural commodities into equities

items.title: SRF extends slide to 5th day, falls 5% to hit 52-wk low on Q2 margin miss
items.description: Today's selling in SRF was seen despite the company reporting a 31 per cent Y-o-Y increase in consolidated net profit to ₹509.12 crore for the quarter ended September.

items.title: Q2 result impact: IGIL shares hit 10% upper circuit; PAT up 43% to ₹185 cr
items.description: For the September quarter, IGIL reported a consolidated PAT of ₹185.8 crore, up 43 per cent Y-o-Y, on healthy demand and strong operational execution.

items.title: KEI Industries share price plunges 10%, nears 52-week low; here's why
items.description: KEI's Q2FY27 EBITDA was in line with estimates, although the EPC business reported a loss during the quarter and C&W margins were below estimates, said analysts at Motilal Oswal.

items.title: Mahindra Finance tanks 10%, hits 52-week low despite 55% surge in Q2 profit
items.description: Mahindra Finance's share price hit a 52-week low of ₹268 on the NSE in Thursday's trading session despite reporting 55% surge in Q2 standalone profit to ₹882 crore.

items.title: Sebi warns investors against fraudulent WhatsApp stock tip groups
items.description: The market regulator warned that unregistered entities use invitation-only WhatsApp groups, fabricated profit testimonials and overseas numbers to lure unsuspecting investors

items.title: Oil price surge keeps Nifty in red, Sensex sheds 460 points on Thursday

items.title: Eternal eyes faster Blinkit expansion as margins and order values grow

items.title: L&T Technology Services eyes stronger H2FY27 growth after Q2 earnings beat
items.description: L&T Technology Services expects stronger growth in the second half of FY27, supported by large-deal ramp-ups, AI-led projects and operational efficiencies after a Q2 earnings beat

items.title: Sebi allows margin relief on subsequent trades against early pay-in
items.description: Sebi has allowed margin relief on subsequent cash-market trades against accepted early pay-in of securities, easing margin requirements for clients with net sell obligations.

items.title: SIP vs Lumpsum: What should investors do in the current sideways market?
items.description: A lump sum has usually beaten staggered investing, but distributors say a sideways market favours spreading it out. A Systematic Transfer Plan (STP) is the middle path

items.title: Sun Pharma accepts bids worth ₹7,816 crore for two five-year bonds
items.description: Sun Pharma has accepted bids worth ₹7,816 crore for two bond tranches maturing in five years and one day, offering annual coupons of 8.05% and 8.20%, merchant bankers said.
